description: Wire the subscription system into the app: update AdminSidebar with lock icons + Subscriptions nav item, update RiderLayout with lock icons, update App.tsx with SubscriptionProvider + LockedRoute wrapping + new routes. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: 1. Update src/components/admin/AdminSidebar.tsx. Add imports: useSubscription from '@/contexts/SubscriptionContext', Lock and Crown from 'lucide-react'. Add 'Subscriptions' item to managementItems array: { title: 'Subscriptions', url: '/admin/subscriptions', icon: Crown }. Inside each nav item render, after the existing {item.title}, add: {!collapsed && isModuleLocked(item.url) && }. Call const { isModuleLocked } = useSubscription() at the top of the AdminSidebar function body. The Subscriptions item itself is never locked so no lock icon appears for it.

2. Update src/components/rider/RiderLayout.tsx. Add imports: useSubscription from '@/contexts/SubscriptionContext', Lock from 'lucide-react'. Call const { isModuleLocked } = useSubscription() inside the RiderLayout function body (after the existing hooks). In the side nav map, add after {item.title}: {isModuleLocked(item.url) && }. In the mobile bottom nav map, wrap the item.icon render with a relative div and add a lock badge:
{isModuleLocked(item.url) && }
.

3. Update src/App.tsx. a) Add import: import { SubscriptionProvider } from '@/contexts/SubscriptionContext'; b) Add import: import LockedRoute from '@/components/LockedRoute'; c) Add import: import UnlockPage from './pages/UnlockPage'; d) Add import: import SubscriptionsPage from './pages/admin/SubscriptionsPage'; e) In the App component's provider tree, wrap with <SubscriptionProvider> inside <AuthProvider> and outside <CartProvider> — the order should be: QueryClientProvider > AuthProvider > SubscriptionProvider > CartProvider > WishlistProvider > TooltipProvider. f) In AnimatedRoutes, add new routes: <Route path='/unlock' element={<UnlockPage />} /> and <Route path='/admin/subscriptions' element={<SubscriptionsPage />} />. g) Wrap the following existing admin routes with LockedRoute: /admin/deals, /admin/categories, /admin/coupons, /admin/customers, /admin/reviews, /admin/riders (both /admin/riders and /admin/riders/:id use moduleKey='/admin/riders'), /admin/delivery-zones, /admin/settings. h) Wrap the following existing rider routes with LockedRoute: /rider/map, /rider/earnings, /rider/wallet, /rider/history, /rider/schedule, /rider/notifications, /rider/chat, /rider/reviews, /rider/performance, /rider/documents, /rider/help, /rider/settings. Syntax for wrapping: <Route path='/admin/deals' element={<LockedRoute moduleKey='/admin/deals'><AdminDeals /></LockedRoute>} />.
acceptance_criteria: AdminSidebar shows a lock icon next to locked admin modules and has a Subscriptions nav item with Crown icon
RiderLayout shows a lock icon next to locked rider modules in the side nav and mobile bottom nav
Navigating to /admin/subscriptions shows the subscriptions management page
Navigating to /unlock shows the unlock/buy page
npm run build completes with exit code 0

App.tsx: added SubscriptionProvider (wrapping CartProvider inside AuthProvider), LockedRoute import, UnlockPage import, SubscriptionsPage import, /unlock route, /admin/subscriptions route, LockedRoute wrapping for 8 admin routes and 12 rider routes as specified.
